01-spectra-and-density/beer-lambert.title: Beer–Lambert and the channel soft minimum
01-spectra-and-density/beer-lambert.about: Spectral densities add at each wavelength; channel densities of the parts do not add up to the channel density of the stack.

01-spectra-and-density/density-noise.title: Density noise and the MAD
01-spectra-and-density/density-noise.about: Density noise is σ_T / (T ln 10): it grows as the film gets denser, and the MAD measures it through outliers.

01-spectra-and-density/linearity.title: Where linearity breaks
01-spectra-and-density/linearity.about: A channel density bends below its tangent in proportion to density and to the squared variation of the dye across the band.

01-spectra-and-density/sigmoid-upsampler.title: Sigmoid upsampling and a metamer
01-spectra-and-density/sigmoid-upsampler.about: Three coefficients pick one smooth spectrum for a colour; a metameric black changes the spectrum but not the colour, and the film sees the difference.

02-forward-model/curve-explorer.title: The characteristic curve
02-forward-model/curve-explorer.about: The two-softplus curve, its slope and its inverse, against Portra 400 data.

02-forward-model/dir-order.title: Coupling before or after the curve
02-forward-model/dir-order.about: A red ramp at fixed green and blue exposure through the coupled film and through a matched matrix after the curve.

02-forward-model/halation-edge.title: Halation across an edge
02-forward-model/halation-edge.about: The same kernel applied to linear exposure, to log exposure or to the developed dye amount.

02-forward-model/print-chain.title: The print chain
02-forward-model/print-chain.about: A grey scale through printer lights, the paper curve, the reflection model and viewing flare.

03-inversion/conditioning-map.title: Conditioning map
03-inversion/conditioning-map.about: σ_min of the Jacobian over the C–M plane for a chosen channel family.

03-inversion/grey-balance.title: Grey balance
03-inversion/grey-balance.about: Printer lights against a density shift on the print, on a grey scale and a skin patch.

03-inversion/lm-path.title: The LM path
03-inversion/lm-path.about: Three solvers on one pixel, over the residual, with the bound c_C = 0.

03-inversion/reachable-classes.title: Reachable set and classes
03-inversion/reachable-classes.about: Blank film, below base and out of gamut as z-tests, with the reachable edge.

04-making-it-fast/blur-cost.title: The cost and error of a separable blur
04-making-it-fast/blur-cost.about: Truncation radius and resolution against the exact Gaussian blur: taps, cost and error in 8-bit levels.

04-making-it-fast/float32-solve.title: The dye solve in 32-bit and 64-bit floats
04-making-it-fast/float32-solve.about: One node of the solve table, solved in float64 and float32: residual and projected-gradient histories against gtol.

04-making-it-fast/lut-error.title: Interpolation error of the dye-solve table
04-making-it-fast/lut-error.about: A slice through the 3-D solve table: exact dye amounts, nodes, and the error of trilinear or tetrahedral lookup.

04-making-it-fast/tile-seams.title: Tiles, halos and seams
04-making-it-fast/tile-seams.about: A blur rendered in tiles with and without a halo, against the one-pass result: the seam error and the cost of the halo.
